item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine launched drones that struck Russia's largest oil refinery in Siberia, while Russia killed a Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant worker in a drone strike and hit a Ukrainian drone strike in Russia's Smolensk region that killed two people. Russia reported intercepting 146 drones in the Leningrad region and a drone that wounded three energy workers in Sumy Oblast. A U.S.-mediated prisoner swap was concluded in Abu Dhabi, but broader peace talks ended without a breakthrough. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel and Hezbollah: the situation
item.description:

Hezbollah has arrested five members in Batroun, maintained artillery fire on Israeli positions and begun cash payments to war victims and displaced families. Former Iraqi MP Ahmed al-Alwani was found dead in Beirut, prompting a probe by France into alleged Israeli war crimes. UN peacekeepers are preparing to exit Lebanon as displaced families face devastation, and Israel’s actions are disrupting ecosystems, including Lebanon’s wheat crop. 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
